functions.name: SecuritySection
params:
{
  config,
  update,
  title,
  accessModeEditable = true,
  hideWorkspaceRestriction = false,
}

callGraph.callee:
checkKeys(model)
        .then((status) => setCredStatus(status as unknown as CredentialStatus))
        .catch

getGatewayStatus()
      .then((status) =>
        setGatewayStatus(status as unknown as GatewayStatusInfo)
      )
      .catch
